title: Redraw Base Price for eNote, Hybrid and Paper Packages (Closing and Funding)
content:
For a Closing and Funding redraw fee refund, the redraw base price is set from the closing method's package format and the borrower's E-SIGN consent: where the method closes on an eNote and the closing carries an E-SIGN consent dated no later than the signing date, it is 90.00; where the method uses electronic signing with a paper note and the closing carries such a consent, it is 110.00; otherwise, for a paper package, it is the closing method's doc redraw fee.

| Closing method | Package format | E-SIGN consent on the closing dated no later than the signing date | Redraw base price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | eNote | Yes | 90.00 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | eNote | No | 150.00 (the method's doc redraw fee) |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | electronic signing, paper note | Yes | 110.00 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | electronic signing, paper note | No | 150.00 (the method's doc redraw fee) |
| Larkspur Traditional Wet, Escrow Dry-Funding, Mobile Notary, Power of Attorney or Mail-Away Closing | paper | any | 150.00 (the method's doc redraw fee) |

Amounts are in US dollars; the doc redraw fee is 150.00 under every closing method.

## Boundary (hypothetical; Hybrid eClosing signed on the 14th)

| E-SIGN consent date on the closing | Redraw base price |
|---|---|
| the 9th | 110.00 |
| the 14th (the signing date itself) | 110.00 |
| the 15th | 150.00 |
| none recorded | 150.00 |
